entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnet new` installs and recommends unlisted package versions #49027
  • Duplicate "System.Reflection.Assembly...Attribute" CS0579 #49002

Closed

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #48864
  • Add Conditions to tool manifest file. #49023
  • There doesn't appear to be an easy way to disable StaticWebAssets caching functionality #48985
  • [10.0-preview.3] NuGetAuditMode=direct flagging transient vulnerabilities #48391
  • DependencyContent.*.RuntimeLibraries is returning libraries that are not used during runtime (code analyzers, build tasks, etc) #48944
  • DOTNET_CLI_HOME usage #9868
    Discussion
  • [feature request] support system as an install location for dotnet tools #11632
  • source-built .NET 10 SDK includes some net4* targets for Microsoft.NET.Build.Extensions #49004
  • [StaticWebAssets] Cache incorrectly updaded when a total update is performed #49010
  • Unable to authenticate against the OpenShift internal registry using a token. #43319
  • Feature Request: "Did you mean ...?" prompting for command typos such as 'consle' #10220
    Backlog
  • Removing "artifacts" from ArtifactsPath cases error #48991

Created

  • Removing 9.0.2xx from codeflow #49025
    Area-CodeFlow

    Area-run-file

    Area-run-file

    Servicing-approved, 9.0.6

    Servicing-approved

    Area-AspNetCore

  • Update branding to 8.0.314 #49018
